body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a build failure in the `@object-ui/fields` package by removing an invalid CSS cross-import. The build was failing because `@import '@object-ui/components/style.css'` resolved to a non-existent source path during Vite build rather than the published package export.

**Changes:**
- Removed `packages/fields/src/index.css` containing the problematic CSS cross-import
- Removed the CSS import statement from `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/fields/src/index.css | Deleted file containing invalid CSS cross-import to @object-ui/components |
| packages/fields/src/index.tsx | Removed import of index.css to eliminate dependency on deleted file |
